name: voice_loop
rule: Do not pick Whisper, a headset, Slack, a TUI, or a speaker in this contract. Every other pipeline stage talks only to Mongo.

inbound_to_pipeline.if_parsed_missing: matcher/OpenClaw skill fills parsed from utterance

outbound_from_pipeline.duty: Get the question in front of the worker by whatever channel. When they answer, insert a new voice_event with parsed.in_reply_to = clarification_id and parsed.intent in {confirm_discrepancy, correct_entry, answer_clarification}.

closed_loop: matcher sees in_reply_to, sets clarifications.status=answered, then committed or flagged
demo_stub_until_channel_exists: Drop JSON files into data/inbox/voice/. That is a valid voice_loop for the hackathon.
